name: prune_batch
description: A sweep's pruneBatch caps how many history images of each kind one pass prunes: two images past retention take two passes of one each, and a pass without a cap then has nothing left to prune. The pinned image stays.

statement.postgres: UPDATE step_history SET recorded_at = now() - interval '400 days' WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM step WHERE ref_id = $1::uuid)
statement.sqlite: UPDATE graph_member_history SET recorded_at = recorded_at - 400 * 86400000000 WHERE kind = 'step' AND id IN (SELECT id FROM graph_member WHERE kind = 'step' AND ref_id = ?1)
